newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK to tender 3-year 6.28 pct govt notes on Oct 14.
newsitem.headline: HK to tender 3-year 6.28 pct govt notes on Oct 14.

text.p: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said on Monday it will tender its thirteenth issue of three-year Exchange Fund notes on October 14.
The HK$500 million notes carry a coupon of 6.28 percent per annum, with interest payable semi-annually in arrears.
The notes will mature on October 15, 1999.
An additional HK$100 million will be held as reserve by the HKMA for supply to market makers in the secondary market.
Settlement will take place on October 15, 1996, it said.
